sample_unit: fall and activity sensor windows (datasets SmartFallMM, UniMib, K-Fall)
unlisted_practices: Using diffusion-based synthetic data augmentation to improve wearable fall detection model training
Evaluating synthetic data quality with distributional metrics (FID, discriminative and predictive scores, JSD, KS)

screen.reason: The study develops and tests synthetic data augmentation (diffusion models and video-based pose estimation) to train an LSTM model for wearable fall detection, evaluating it offline and in a real-time mobile app setting, but it focuses on model training/accuracy rather than testing health system deployment practices or guardrails.
